rule: A gate may only be relaxed by a DECISIONS.md entry naming approver, reason, expiry. Silent gate removal is a policy violation. G13 is NEVER waivable.

gates.purpose: Section order (N+1 without N accepted fails)
gates.check: scripts/lib/gates/g2-section-order.mjs evaluateG2 (plain-JS mirror of sectionLockViolation in packages/schemas/src/progressive.ts; run by node scripts/check-gates.mjs)

gates.purpose: No placeholder content / unregistered numeric claims
gates.check: scripts/lib/gates/g3-placeholder-claims.mjs evaluateG3 (filler text, TODO/placeholder markers, numeric claims absent from the claims register; run by node scripts/check-gates.mjs)

gates.purpose: A11y floor: zero serious/critical axe + criteria-to-evidence map (not an AA conformance claim)
Perf budgets: lab vs field as separate fields; TBT is the INP lab proxy
Motion parity: reduced-motion equivalence preserving information/operation
gates.check: scripts/lib/gates/g6-motion-parity.mjs evaluateG6 (information-token parity between default and reduced-motion traces, both directions, fail-closed; run by node scripts/check-gates.mjs)

gates.purpose: Reflow: 320px equivalence, 400% zoom, standard exceptions; no overflow-hiding
gates.check: scripts/lib/gates/g7-reflow.mjs evaluateG7 — 320 CSS px overflow + overflow-hidden-instead-of-reflow measured from harness viewport records; the 400% zoom equivalence component reports not-run because the harness does not drive browser zoom (run by node scripts/check-gates.mjs)

gates.purpose: Target size >= 24x24 with standard exceptions (project minimums are policy, not the standard)
gates.check: scripts/lib/gates/g8-target-size.mjs evaluateG8 — 24x24 CSS px floor with only SC 2.5.8 exceptions (inline, equivalent, user-agent, essential); project 44px is policy, not the standard (run by node scripts/check-gates.mjs)

gates.purpose: Semantics: headings, landmarks, focus-visible, no click-only controls
gates.check: scripts/lib/gates/g9-semantics.mjs evaluateG9 (heading ladder, main landmark, click-only controls, removed focus indicator without replacement; run by node scripts/check-gates.mjs)

gates.purpose: Detector precision/recall >= target before any rule ships as blocking
gates.check: scripts/lib/gates/g10-detector-precision.mjs evaluateG10 over the labelled corpus cases in scripts/gates/fixtures/g10-good.json, which node scripts/check-gates.mjs cross-checks against live @sus/scanners scanText so a stale fixture fails
gates.targetProvenance: Measured 1.0 precision / 1.0 recall on the 12-case labelled corpus (packages/scanners/corpus; .sus-dev/VERIFICATION/T0305.md). Target set at 0.95 = the highest value below the measured result that still tolerates one error per 20 evaluations; on the current corpus any single misclassification scores 0.75, so drift fails. Provenance: docs/PRD_GAP_ANALYSIS.md F4 requires the target to be set before rules ship as blocking.

gates.purpose: Evidence completeness: bundle present and schema-valid
Contract drift: code tokens vs DESIGN_CONTRACT.md divergence report
gates.check: packages/tokens evaluateG12 (fail-closed drift gate) + sus-tokens gates CLI

gates.purpose: Critical security/privacy: fail-closed denial, injection quarantine, privacy defaults — NEVER waivable
gates.badFixture: packages/studio-bridge/tests/security.test.ts (undefended attempt / redaction residue / consent-skip / retention-of-material / claimed-not-applicable negatives)

semanticPrerequisites.why: dual-stack mapping spike needs both framework fixtures (Next + Astro)
baselines need the evidence-bundle schema they are recorded with
first mutating Studio slice needs request replay/idempotence contract
first mutating Studio slice needs crash/restart recovery
final private push follows the full regression sweep
